'''Jacob Taylor''' (DeckTech handle '''Armaedes''')<ref name="dt-23249">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23249 Jacob's BHBM aka Blame Canada], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 9 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23249/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23249/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009181947/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23249/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech (''Jacob's BHBM aka Blame Canada''). Jacob posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] list on DeckTech (''Jacob's Profit aka Big Trouble'')<ref name="dt-22978">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22978 Jacob's Profit aka Big Trouble], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 25 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22978/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22978/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009213759/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22978/ Wayback Machine].</ref>.
